a: Run many fast unit tests, fewer integration tests, selective e2e in CI.
Quarantine flaky tests, fix them, do not ignore forever.
Shard tests across CI workers to cut wall time.
Testcontainers spin real DBs/brokers in Docker for integration tests.
Treat snapshot changes as intentional reviews, not auto-accept.
Coverage gates prevent large untested drops but are not a quality guarantee.
Run consumer-driven contracts so providers do not break clients.
Post-deploy smoke tests verify critical paths in the real environment.
Deterministic seeds make integration tests stable and readable.
Freeze time in tests that depend on clocks and schedules.
